tested_hypothesis.description: Use raw u8 object indexing for the marker store after the typed count store. Unlike the previously tested typed-field reorder, this tests whether the Header lvalue's alias/type domain caused GC/1.3 to end the 0xFF temporary before memset argument setup.
tested_hypothesis.result: Raw byte access did not extend the constant's live range: the compiler still selected r5 and stored the marker before loading the memset size. The variant regressed and was discarded; the 99.861786% reconstruction was restored.
